subject: community-medicine
title: Poliomyelitis: Paralysis Surveillance and the Endgame

steps.title: An enterovirus that mostly hides
steps.tx: **Poliovirus** spreads faeco orally, infects the gut and throat of far more people than it paralyses, and reaches motor neurons in well under one percent of infections. Most infections are silent or a brief fever, which is why paralysis surveillance must be paired with environmental and population immunity data to know where virus still travels.
steps.say: For every paralysed child, hundreds are silently infected. Faeco oral spread, motor neurons rarely reached. Silence is this virus's camouflage and surveillance's problem.

steps.title: Acute flaccid paralysis surveillance
steps.tx: **AFP surveillance** requires immediate notification of every case of acute flaccid paralysis in children under fifteen, plus any age when polio is suspected, with two stool samples collected twenty four hours apart within fourteen days of onset and shipped cold to accredited laboratories. Timeliness and stool adequacy rates audit whether surveillance would actually catch imported virus.
steps.say: Every floppy child under fifteen, reported at once, two stools a day apart within fourteen days, cold shipped. Adequacy percentages tell whether the net has holes.

nodes.label: Two stools 24 h apart, within 14 days

steps.title: The paralysis pattern at the bedside
steps.tx: **Poliomyelitis paralysis** is asymmetric, flaccid and proximal more than distal, with reflexes lost, sensation intact and no bladder involvement, evolving over days with fever at onset. Guillain Barre syndrome, the great mimic, tends to symmetry and ascending spread. Residual paralysis review at sixty days classifies AFP outcomes for the programme.
steps.say: Asymmetric, flaccid, feeling intact, reflexes gone, fever at onset. Guillain Barre climbs symmetrically. Sixty day review sorts residue from recovery for the register.

steps.title: India's last case and certification
steps.tx: **India's last wild polio case** occurred in January 2011 in West Bengal, and the South East Asia Region was certified polio free in March 2014 after surveillance proved absence, not merely silence. Pulse Polio rounds vaccinating every child under five on national days, booth plus house to house, built the immunity wall that made interruption possible.
steps.say: Last Indian case January 2011, regional certification March 2014. Pulse rounds, booth then doorstep, built the wall. Certification audited silence until it proved absence.

steps.title: OPV: gut immunity with a rare price
steps.tx: The **oral polio vaccine** replicates briefly in the gut, inducing strong intestinal immunity that blocks transmission and spreads secondarily to contacts, which powered eradication rounds. Its rare costs are vaccine associated paralytic poliomyelitis in recipients or contacts, and circulating vaccine derived polioviruses where coverage gaps let vaccine virus keep transmitting and mutate back toward virulence.
steps.say: OPV blocks transmission in the gut and immunises contacts free. Rare paralysis and vaccine derived outbreaks in undercovered pockets are its price. Coverage decides which face shows.

steps.title: IPV: blood immunity without replication
steps.tx: **Inactivated polio vaccine** given by injection induces strong blood antibody preventing paralysis but weaker gut immunity, so vaccinated people can still carry and shed virus silently. Fractional intradermal doses stretch supply in the programme. In the endgame, IPV anchors individual protection while OPV withdraws in a globally synchronised sequence.
steps.say: IPV guards the nervous system, less so the gut; silent carriage continues. Fractional skin doses stretch vials. It anchors protection as oral vaccine retires.

steps.title: The switch and containment era
steps.tx: The **global switch** in 2016 withdrew type 2 oral vaccine worldwide simultaneously after type 2 eradication, replacing trivalent with bivalent OPV plus IPV introduction, because most vaccine derived outbreaks were type 2. Laboratories and manufacturers now destroy or contain poliovirus stocks under strict global action plan rules to prevent re seeding.
steps.say: In 2016 the world retired type 2 oral vaccine on one calendar to stop vaccine derived type 2 outbreaks. Containment rules now guard every stored vial.

steps.title: Environmental surveillance: sewage tells
steps.tx: **Environmental surveillance** samples sewage at sentinel sites to detect poliovirus circulation before any child is paralysed, repeatedly proving its worth by finding silent transmission and importations in polio free cities. A single positive sample triggers risk assessment, coverage review and targeted vaccination without waiting for a clinical case.
steps.say: Sewage speaks before children fall. One positive sample starts investigation and targeted rounds. Waiting for paralysis wastes the warning the drains provided.

steps.title: What remains: Afghanistan, Pakistan and importation risk
steps.tx: **Wild poliovirus type 1** persists endemically only in Afghanistan and Pakistan corridors, while vaccine derived outbreaks flare where routine immunisation collapsed. Every polio free country therefore maintains AFP and environmental surveillance, high routine coverage and outbreak response stockpile access until global certification closes the file permanently.
steps.say: Type 1 survives in two country corridors; vaccine derived fires start wherever coverage collapsed. Surveillance and routine rounds stay until the world, not the map, is certified.
